features: DATABASE CHANGES: NEW COLUMNS, TWO SETTINGS AND FOUR PREFERENCES, NO DATA REWRITTEN — The update runs three new migrations and one settings migration on its own. Tickets and communications have two new fields, attachment access and moderation: existing ones get «Aperti» (open) and moderation on. Documents have two new fields, who approved a file and when. General settings have two new entries: «Allegati in moderazione di serie» (moderate attachments by default), on, and «Numero massimo di allegati per elemento» (maximum attachments per item), 5. Every user has four new notification preferences for attachments, on or off like the matching comment preferences. The default roles receive the sixteen new attachment permissions (below); roles you created yourself do not, and you grant them if you wish. The update rewrites no data and changes no record. Each migration checks what is already there: if it stops halfway, it resumes from where it got to. No new library; requirements do not change. After the update, reload the pages you already have open.

NEW: ATTACHMENTS FOR TICKETS AND COMMUNICATIONS — A ticket or a communication can carry files: photos in JPG, PNG or WebP and documents in PDF, up to five per item, each within the document size limit. The number can be changed in the general settings, from 1 to 50. Files are added in the creation form or from the detail page. The detail page lists them with name, format, size, who uploaded it and when, and the «Apri» (open) and «Scarica» (download) buttons: no photo opens by itself in the page. When the document storage is full, new files are refused. Whoever uploaded a file can rename or delete it. When a ticket or a communication is deleted, including together with its building or with the user who wrote it, its attachments go with it, rows and files; if the deletion fails, they stay.

NEW: WHO SEES THEM, WHO ADDS THEM, WHO APPROVES THEM — For each ticket and communication you choose the attachment access from the detail page. «Aperti» (open): whoever sees the item sees and downloads the files. «Solo consultazione» (read-only): in the portal files can be seen and downloaded, but no new ones added. «Solo amministrazione» (administration only): in the portal files are not shown. You also choose whether new files await approval: with moderation on, all of them wait except those of users who can approve them; off, those of users allowed to publish them go out at once. New items start from «Allegati in moderazione di serie» in the general settings. From the portal, files can be added to a ticket by people in the building, and to a communication only by its author, always with the permission to upload them.

NEW: SIXTEEN ATTACHMENT PERMISSIONS — Eight for tickets and eight for communications, like those for comments: upload, publish, approve, edit, edit own, delete, delete own, view. The administrator has them all. The collaborator uploads and publishes files, renames and deletes their own and sees them, on tickets and communications; they do not approve and do not touch other people's files. Residents and suppliers do the same on tickets, and on communications they only see the files. Approving, renaming or deleting other people's files and changing an item's access require both the admin panel and the permission: the permission alone, given to a resident, opens nothing.

NEW: THE «ALLEGATI» (ATTACHMENTS) PAGE — The admin menu has an «Allegati» entry with the number of files awaiting approval. The page gathers the files of all buildings: you filter them by status, type, building, author and date, approve and delete them also in bulk, and «Scarica in ZIP» downloads them with one folder per building, type and item, together with an elenco.csv list. A file awaiting approval also opens an Inbox entry, which closes by itself when the item has no more files to approve.

NEW: ATTACHMENT EMAILS — As with comments, an upload sends a single email, even with several files: to the people following the ticket or the readers of the communication, to those who must approve them when they are pending, to the author when their file is approved or deleted by someone else. Emails link to the detail page, never to the file, and the uploader does not receive their own. They are switched on and off in the notification preferences, with four new entries.

CHANGED: THE TICKET DETAIL PAGE — At the top, the ticket and its parameters sit side by side at the same height; a long description opens with «Leggi tutto» (read more). Below, comments and attachments sit side by side in two columns. Comments have a box for when there are none, and the attachment settings are changed in a dialog, with an explanation of each choice.

CHANGED: VISIBILITY FILTER IN THE TICKET AND COMMUNICATION LISTS — In the admin lists you can filter tickets and communications that are published, draft, awaiting approval or private. In the tickets table, status, priority and visibility stay on one line, and the «In attesa di approvazione» label becomes «Da approvare» (to approve).

CHANGED: THE «AUDIT E LOGS» PAGE — The page has the header with the breadcrumb and three short guides. The email log can be filtered by status (sent, not sent, failed), by sending method and by dates, with a button that clears the filters, and shows 10, 25, 50 or 100 rows per page. A wrong filter in the address brings you back to the page without filters.

CHANGED: THE CHART OF ACCOUNTS PAGES — Creating and editing a chart of accounts has the header with three short guides and the fields in two boxes, «Dati principali» (main details) and «Note interne» (internal notes), with «Annulla» (cancel) and «Salva» (save) at the bottom right, as in the management forms. The creation page title is «Nuovo piano dei conti».
